extra.final_summary:
Average flipper length (mm) by species, using 53 rows after removing 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 9 and 22):
- Adelie: 190.375
- Chinstrap: 196.0
- Gentoo: 215.3913

Data quality: species labels were all valid (no variants/misspellings), flipper_length_mm was fully numeric and within the allowed 170–235 range. The only issue affecting this question was 2 exact duplicate rows, which I removed (approved) so penguins aren't double-counted. Other columns (island misspellings, sex case variants, body_mass_g text numbers) were not needed for this question and were left unchanged.
